change: Checkpoint-to-reference projection performs one complete checkpoint admission instead of two consecutive clones.

after.scope: Mac execution; Windows-only test bodies returning on this platform do not grant Windows qualification.

invariants: digest recomputed from owned normalized fields
root policy, identity, binding, budget, ledger, publication and source validation unchanged
no persistent or cross-call authority cache
original limits, authentication, expiration and durable ACK semantics unchanged
regressions: valid digest with invalid budget rejected
tampered digest and mutated expiry rejected
empty/invalid/hostile getter/Proxy rejected without invoking hooks

profile.conclusion: No measured end-to-end speed improvement. Windows five-second and full-root timeout remain unresolved.
